verdict.rationale: Skills are plain Markdown/YAML folders on the filesystem that follow the published Agent Skills open standard, which is documented as working across multiple AI tools. A hands-on probe confirmed the official skills install via third-party tooling with no Anthropic account and read back as spec-conformant files, so locally authored skills are already in an open format and portable. However, nothing documents exporting skills uploaded to a workspace through the Skills API, or any bulk 'export all my data' path. missing for 10: documented export/download of API-uploaded workspace skills and versions, an explicit all-data export mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Claude Code skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard, which works across multiple AI tools.
We've published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability.
The `SKILL.md` file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
the repo's skills are plain, spec-conformant markdown folders installable by third-party tooling, no Anthropic account needed.
